patch.value: Repair only unsupported answer components within a fresh budget

Evidence-directed repair resumes declared gaps while retaining valid supported components. Overlap check: host SDK provides certified reads, transactions, history, status roles and leases; pm-rlm evidence diagnoses gaps, adaptive plans initial work, reuse selects one complete call, reconciliation compares arms; pm-evidence manages citations and pm-rl evaluates policies. None schedules targeted repair of a partially supported answer.

One unsupported part among ten causes work only for that part and invalidated dependencies; budget exhaustion retains the supported answer with named gaps; no missing part is silently dropped. Typed SDK and CLI, compact TOON/JSON, strict schemas and remedies, no-git real public corpus validation, seeded state and interleaving evidence, npm and Bun CI gates.
